pr_title: Fix Z-Wave JS sensor units and device classes
pr_body:

## Breaking change
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
- Bump zwave-js-server-python to 0.44.0.
- https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/zwave-js-server-python/releases/tag/0.44.0
- This fixes a bug where the meter and multilevel sensor enum collection constants didn't contain all the members as they were sets instead of a container that allowed duplicate values. This caused the device class look up using the unit to fail.
- Fix sensors having a device class with a not allowed unit of measurement. Refactor our entity description lookup to solve this by first using the unit in the lookup.

issue_context.body:
### The problem

Using the ZWave JS UI Add-On with Zooz ZEN40 (500 and 700 series) sensors, the system is now reporting warnings about invalid unit.

These sensors report illuminance in percentage, not lux.
